column1: # Traditional only treats a singleton ~* header value as regex. Compatible
# transforms each mixed-list value separately. Keep both routing candidates.
# Literal header values and names are case-insensitive; any repeated value may match.
# Configured host literals retain their case. Only lowercase request hosts are
# sampled. The uppercase alternative makes the matching lower alias incomplete
# in the current model; do not promote that observation to exact coverage.
